Album description
The iconic debut of UKF Bass Culture series that captured the peak of the early-2010s dubstep and D&B boom. Spanning over 40 tracks, it featured heavyweight anthems from legends like Foreign Beggars, Skrillex, Flux Pavilion, Feed Me, Chase & Status, and Camo & Krooked. Released as a double CD on August 1, 2011, this album holds a legendary status within the electronic music community. Beyond its star-studded roster, the compilation is celebrated as a cultural milestone that documented the exact moment UK bass music went from underground UK clubs to becoming a dominant global phenomenon. This became more apparent when UKF held a massive rave at London’s iconic Alexandra Palace, selling out to a 12,000-person capacity of the venue.
The album was an immediate commercial success. It debuted on the Official UK Charts on August 13, 2011, where it aggressively climbed to a peak position of #10 on the compilation charts—a rare feat for an album strictly dedicated to electronic bass music at the time.
